# Mary Stubbs

## Overview

- **Age:** 12 years old (in volume 5)  <sub>[v5 c5 P49](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0049), [v5 c5 P51](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0051)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c5 P16](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0016), [v5 c5 P38](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0038)</sub>
- **Role:** Domestic helper and pupil  <sub>[v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary has long, pale, unusual eyes, a pretty mouth, and white, even teeth. Under Mrs. Kerr's care, her face fills out with rosy cheeks and crimped hair, giving her a well-fed and attractive appearance compared to the ragged stray who escaped to Glen St. Agnes.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c7 P11](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0011), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 c31 P28](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0028)_

## Personality

Mary is lively, outspoken, proud, and inclined to boast about herself. Subjected to severe physical abuse and neglect in her early childhood, she retains a deep fear of punishment and ghost stories, which she tells with dramatic flair. Though sometimes quick-tempered, jealous, and prone to lecturing or sharing upsetting gossip, she is intensely loyal to her friends and capable of genuine remorse and affection.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028), [v5 c5 P48](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0048), [v5 c5 P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087), [v5 c5 P106](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0106), [v5 c6 P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030), [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c8 P51](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0051), [v5 c18 P11](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0011), [v5 c23 P5](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0005), [v5 c25 P11](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0011), [v5 c33 P1](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0001)_

## Goals

- To avoid being sent back to abusive guardians or hard orphanages  <sub>[v5 c5 P47](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0047), [v5 c5 P108](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0108), [v5 c9 P20](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0020)</sub>
- To remain in Seven Gulls surrounded by her friends  <sub>[v5 c8 P51](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0051)</sub>

## History

After running away from the abusive Mrs. Grimble across the harbor, Mary hid in a barn near the manse at Glen St. Agnes without food for days. She surrendered to the manse children, who fed her and gave her clothes. After learning of Mrs. Grimble's sudden death from heart disease, Mary feared she might be sent back to the Hopetown asylum. Mr. Ashdown comforted her in his study, and Ida Ashdown pleaded with Winifred Kerr to adopt Mary. Mrs. Kerr took Mary into her household, where Mary proved to be an exceptionally energetic domestic worker and pupil. She became a constant playmate of the manse and Hollowmere children in Fern Hollow, frequently sharing spine-tingling ghost stories, giving advice, and inadvertently causing alarm with her warnings about stepmothers.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P17](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0017), [v5 c5 P21](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0021), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c5 P33](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0033), [v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c6 P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c9 P5](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0005), [v5 c9 P17](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0017), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036), [v5 c23 P82](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0082), [v5 c29 P0](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Grandfather was a wealthy man, but her parents squandered the money on alcohol and abused her  <sub>[v5 c5 P55](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0055), [v5 c5 P57](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0057)</sub>
- Orphaned at age six after her mother hanged herself and her father slit his throat  <sub>[v5 c5 P53](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0053)</sub>
- Spent two years in an asylum at Hopetown before being taken at age eight by Mrs. Grimble  <sub>[v5 c5 P51](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0051)</sub>
- Endured four years of severe beatings and starvation under Mrs. Grimble across the harbor  <sub>[v5 c5 P49](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0049), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008)</sub>
